message: Start with a real space clue, invent an organism from another dimension, then test the idea like a scientist and a game designer.
originStory: Mythical Void began as a father-and-son question shared by Kevin and his nine-year-old son: what could imagination and generative AI tools make possible?
socialSequence: download the activity and play the game
requiredClaims: The activity is free and four pages long.
The suggested audience is ages 9-14, families, clubs and classrooms.
Younger designers should work with an adult.
The activity separates real observations from fictional ideas.
Mythical Void is independent and NASA does not endorse it.
privacyRules: Do not collect names, ages, faces, voices, schools, locations or contact details from children.
Do not invite children to send their designs directly.
Only share a young person's work later with adult permission and without identifying details.
firstTwoWeekQuestions: Did people open the NASA and STEM page?
Did they choose the activity download?
Did they move from the activity page to Play?
Which message earned a useful adult reply?
